interpretations: Inner join telescopes to observatories on observstation. Group by lunarstage, with NULL lunarstage as its own group. Per group, the average of non-null bandusagepct and the count of all telescopes (COUNT(*)). The threshold is the unweighted mean of the group averages, including the missing-phase group. Keep groups with average strictly above the threshold. Return (1) the average of the kept groups' averages, (2) the sum of the kept groups' telescope counts, (3) the average of (group average − threshold) over the kept groups
Same as above, but the count per phase is only telescopes with non-null bandusagepct (COUNT(bandusagepct))
Same as above, but the count per phase is the number of distinct telescregistry values
Same as above, but the threshold is the overall mean of bandusagepct across all joined telescopes (a telescope-weighted mean) instead of the mean of the phase averages
Same as above, but the missing-phase group also includes empty-string or placeholder lunarstage values, and not only NULL
Same as above, but a phase whose bandusagepct values are all NULL has a NULL average. It is excluded from the threshold calculation and can never be kept
Same as above, but a phase whose bandusagepct values are all NULL is treated as having average 0 and included in the threshold calculation
Same as above, but "above the mean" is read as greater than or equal to the mean
Same as above, but the third value is the total excess (sum of group average − threshold) across kept groups, and not the average excess
Same as above, but the third value is the kept groups' average of the excess measured against the weighted overall mean, while the filter uses the mean of the phase averages

Same as above, but the second value is a telescope-level count of rows in kept phases after the join, where each telescope is counted once. This is the same as the sum of counts if the join is one-to-one
Same as above, but the first value is the telescope-weighted average of bandusagepct across all telescopes in kept phases, and not the simple average of the phase averages
Same as the first interpretation, but the count per phase is the number of distinct observatories (distinct observstation) in that phase, not telescopes
Same as the first interpretation, but the threshold is computed only over the non-missing phases. The missing-phase group is still its own group and is filtered against that threshold
Same as the first interpretation, but lunarstage values are normalized (trimmed and case-folded) before grouping, so variants like "full" and "Full " fall into the same phase
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage AS lunarstage,
         AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_band,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
th AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_band) AS threshold FROM g
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_band) AS avg_of_kept_averages,
       SUM(g.cnt) AS total_telescope_count,
       AVG(g.avg_band - th.threshold) AS avg_diff_from_threshold
FROM g, th
WHERE g.avg_band > th.threshold;
SELECT o.lunarstage, COUNT(t.bandusagepct) FROM observatories o JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage
SELECT o.lunarstage, COUNT(DISTINCT t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes t
JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
GROUP BY o.lunarstage;
SELECT o.lunarstage
FROM telescopes t
JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
GROUP BY o.lunarstage
HAVING AVG(t.bandusagepct) > (
  SELECT AVG(t2.bandusagepct)
  FROM telescopes t2
  JOIN observatories o2 ON t2.observstation = o2.observstation
);
SELECT CASE WHEN lunarstage IS NULL OR TRIM(lunarstage) = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(lunarstage)) IN ('n/a', 'na', 'null', 'unknown', 'none', '-', '?') THEN 'Missing' ELSE lunarstage END AS lunar_phase, COUNT(*) AS observatory_count
FROM observatories
GROUP BY 1
WITH phase_avg AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage
  FROM observatories o
  JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
)
SELECT lunarstage, avg_bandusage
FROM phase_avg
WHERE avg_bandusage IS NOT NULL
  AND avg_bandusage > (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) FROM phase_avg WHERE avg_bandusage IS NOT NULL);
